answer.summary: The API Types Check failed because the generated TypeScript API types are out of date with the backend DTOs this PR changed. The job prints a diff adding new fields (e.g. consistency_mode, has_more) and tells the author to regenerate types before committing. This is deterministic and will repeat on re-run; the fix is to run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the updated api-types.d.ts.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
